lesson_points: A declaration pairs a type and name; initialization supplies a first value, and assignment changes it.
Practice int, float, double and char, with suitable printf formats.
Names are case sensitive. Do not read an uninitialized automatic local.
current_objective: Declare float: declare resource as float, apply resource + 1.5, and print each result with %.1f. Dataset 1 starts with [-3, 0, 9, 12]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
validation_scope: Parameter proposal only; runtime construction, output checks, solvability and publication are still required.
